name: jairf-liveops
description: JAIRF localization, accessibility, live-ops, monetization & moderation roadmap (per 09_Localization_Accessibility_LiveOps.md). Localization: string keys everywhere, Unity Localization, pluralization/variables, multi-language, font support. Accessibility: colorblind palettes, scalable UI, remappable controls, subtitles/CC, screen reader, motion options, non-color-only feedback. Live-ops: timed events, calendar, event quests/rewards, announcements, feature flags, analytics. Monetization (ethical): cosmetics/comfort/builder extras over power, clear separation, seasons optional. Moderation: reporting, automated filters, review queue, quarantine/rollback, guidelines, rate limiting, GM tools. CI/CD: branching, validation, Addressables pipeline, tests, review gates, semantic versioning.

phases.name: 2. Accessibility suite (palette, scaling, remap, captions, motion options)
3. Live-ops & events (features flags, calendar, announcements, analytics)
5. UGC moderation & safety (filters, review queue, GM tools)
6. CI/CD + version control for the agent swarm
